plainText:
Miyuu Sawai (Japanese: 沢井美優 Sawai Miyū) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Sawai was born on October 23, 1987, in , . As an adult, she became a model and gravure idol, working since at least 2002. She later became a voice actress and worked on some anime series. Sawai voiced Astrid, a with a who appeared in of . In addition, she has acted in several live-action works. Sawai is currently affiliated with BOX Corporation.
